en.title: FAMILY BUSINESS (ARABIC)
en.subtitle: ENGLISH
en.synopsis: A poor family struggles to survive through small acts of theft, while the father dreams of a better life for his children. After an incident that nearly lands him in prison, he decides to abandon crime, only to realize that reality offers them no real opportunities. He then comes up with a different plan: instead of stealing money, each member of the family secretly secures a job inside the home of an extremely wealthy family, without anyone knowing they are related. Living under the same roof as strangers, they constantly face the stark contrast between their world and the world of their employers. As tension rises alongside moments of dark comedy, a major event threatens to expose everything, leaving everyone with a difficult question: can a happy ending truly be built on deception?

brands.company_name_en: Gulf Brand For Fast Food CO
brands.description_en: The Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company (GBFF), exclusive master franchisee of the US fried chicken giant Popeyes, has opened its fourth restaurant in Riyadh. After opening its first Popeyes restaurant on Anas Bin Malik Street in Riyadh which offers a bright and vibrant family-friendly atmosphere and a convenient Drive thru, GBFF opened two cloud kitchens restaurants, and its latest restaurant on Imam Saud Road in Massif, Riyadh. Guests can look forward to enjoying Popeyes world-famous products, such as the brand’s signature Chicken Sandwich, Chicken on the bone, and Tenders, perfectly marinated for 12 hours in a unique blend of Louisiana seasonings.Founded in New Orleans in the United States in 1972, Popeyes has over 45 years of history and culinary tradition with over 3,600 locations in more than 25 countries. Popeyes is one the world’s largest chicken quick-service restaurants serving chicken dishes in bold and spicy flavors. Popeyes introduces for the first time in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia its hero Sandwich “The SANDWICH” which comes to you along with the whole menu items 100% local and fresh sourced chicken from Tanmiah Farms.GBFF is planning to open hundreds of new Popeyes restaurants in the Kingdom over the coming years.The Popeyes restaurant with mouth-watering crunchy and juicy fried chicken bursting with Louisiana flavor can quickly establish itself as a lifestyle-led hospitality leader. The new restaurant is designed with the precise needs of the cosmopolitan Saudi market in mind to bring a unique, world-class addition to the Kingdom’s ever-evolving dining scene. GBFF aims to make Popeyes available to guests in every place in the Kingdom through digital platforms, including the mobile app & website.Gulf Brand Fast-Food Company’s strategy to develop the Popeyes presence in the Kingdom will allow it to create hundreds of career opportunities and share the joy of Popeyes with the people of Saudi Arabia.
